newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer says higher 1997 profits realistic.
newsitem.headline: Bayer says higher 1997 profits realistic.

text.p: German chemicals firm Bayer AG said on Tuesday that it had a realistic chance to top its 1996 profits this year.
"We have a good chance that we will match the 1996 profit and a realistic chance that we will top it," Bayer chief executive Manfred Schneider told a news briefing.
Schneider said the group's planning is realistically cautious because of concerns about price levels.
Bayer had said that despite an expectation for stonger growth, increased international competition would make it difficult to significantly adjust prices.
